basic_info.description: This stunning high-floor D Plan residence at One Hawthorne offers unobstructed Twin Peaks views, a spacious office alcove, and a thoughtfully designed layout. Expansive windows flood the home with natural light, while the sleek Bosch-equipped kitchen and Studio Becker cabinetry add modern sophistication. The generous bedroom features a custom walk-in closet, and the spa-like bathroom boasts a deep soaking tub. Located in one of San Francisco's most desirable downtown addresses, this home puts you steps from LinkedIn, Salesforce, Google, SF MoMA, Michelin-starred Benu, and Gallery Row. Exclusive building amenities include a newly redesigned 24-hour attended lobby, valet parking with EV charging, a 26th-floor rooftop terrace, and a state-of-the-art fitness center. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a high-floor residence with breathtaking views in the heart of San Francisco. Welcome home!
